WBD.thesis_one_line: Media giant whose shares are tied to a $31 cash takeover by Paramount; little upside, big drop if regulators block it.
kill_criteria: Court enjoins the merger, or WBD/PSKY announce termination, before the 4 Mar 2027 outside date (extendable to 4 Jun 2027).
WBD share price below $29.50 (about 5% under the cash price) for 5 consecutive sessions, signalling the market doubts closing.
Net leverage above 3.8x (company definition, consolidated) in any quarterly release.
Consolidated adj. EBITDA below $1.7bn in any quarter.
Any 8-K reporting failure of the Ellison guarantee ($45.72bn of consideration) or a reduction of the $31.00 price.
key_adverse_facts: 12 state attorneys general and the Writers Guild sued in July 2026 to block the PSKY merger (10-Q Note 15)
Q2-26 revenue -11% y/y, studios adj. EBITDA -89%, advertising -22% (8-K 0001437107-26-000072)
$32.0bn carrying-value debt, $33.1bn gross; $2.8bn Netflix termination fee expensed in Q1-26
No numeric guidance; Q4-25 distribution revenue -3% vs "low single digit" growth said in Nov 2025
data_conflicts: b1 shows composite momentum 0.97 (12-1m +46%) driven by the bid, not operations
Post-cutoff headlines (30 Sep 2026 settlement approval) unverified against primary filings
WBD.next_earnings_date_basis: estimate; may not occur if the merger closes first
WBD.confidence_in_thesis: high: the price is set by a signed $31.00 cash merger agreement (10-Q Note 1)

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row. Standalone, the price implies about 13.9% a year 10-year FCF growth against a base of about 3%; price is supported only by the $31.00 cash offer.

WBD.scenario_basis: Bear: deal breaks, shares at $20 in 3 years, no dividend. Base/bull: $31.00 cash received within months, reinvested at about 4% (cash) to a 3-year horizon, from the $30.86 close. Not an operating-earnings forecast.

GPC.thesis_one_line: Century-old car and industrial parts distributor with a rising dividend, fairly priced, splitting in two in 2027 while cash flow lags profit.
kill_criteria: Full-year 2026 free cash flow guidance cut below $550m, or TTM OCF less capex below $500m at any quarter-end.
Adjusted diluted EPS guidance midpoint cut below $7.50 at any release.
Consolidated total debt (short-term borrowings plus current and long-term debt, carrying value) above $5.5bn at any quarter-end.
Separation completion slips beyond 30 Jun 2027 or is cancelled.
Comparable sales growth below 1.0% for two consecutive quarters.
key_adverse_facts: 2025 free cash flow $421m vs dividends $564m; H1-26 FCF $259m vs dividends $288m (8-Ks)
July 2026: GAAP EPS outlook cut to $5.90-$6.40 from $6.10-$6.60; North America sales growth cut to 2.5%-4.5% from 3%-5%
Q4-25 one-time non-cash pension settlement charge; GAAP EPS -$4.38
Separation and restructuring costs rising (restructuring 1.1% of Q2 sales vs 0.7%)
data_conflicts: b1 earnings yield 0.2% reflects GAAP charges; adjusted EPS guide $7.50-$8.00 gives about 6% yield
b1 value-family 0.48 is neutral while fcfp 4.2% matches TTM OCF less capex of $760m
GPC.next_earnings_date_basis: estimate from the 21 Oct 2025 date; not confirmed
GPC.confidence_in_thesis: medium: stable cash-generative franchise, but FCF conversion and separation outcome are unproven

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row. Reverse DCF implies about 7.1% a year 10-year FCF growth from TTM FCF $760m vs my base of about 6%; priced for a slightly faster recovery than evidenced.

GPC.scenario_basis: Starting adj. EPS guide midpoint $7.75; bear flat EPS at 13x; base +6.5%/yr at 16x; bull +8.5%/yr at 18x; dividend about $4.3/yr (derived); 3-year horizon from $129.61.

MAA.thesis_one_line: Owner of about 100,000 Sun Belt apartments paying a 5% dividend, with rents set to recover as new building slows.
kill_criteria: Net debt/adjusted EBITDAre (company TTM definition, consolidated) above 5.0x at any quarter-end.
2026 Core FFO guidance midpoint cut below $8.30 per share.
Same-store effective blended lease rate growth below 0.0% in both Q3-26 and Q4-26.
Same-store physical occupancy below 94.5% for two consecutive quarters.
RealPage settlement rejected at final approval, or any new settlement or judgment payment above $25m.
key_adverse_facts: Core FFO per share down three years: $8.88 (2024), $8.74 (2025), $8.53 guide midpoint (2026)
Net debt/adjusted EBITDAre 4.5x at 30 Jun 2026 vs 4.3x at 31 Dec 2025
July 2026: same-store NOI growth guide top end cut to 0.10% from 0.30%; revenue growth cut to -0.20% to 0.40%
RealPage antitrust class settlement of $53.0m awaiting final approval; attorneys general appealing
data_conflicts: b1 composite rank 402/402 uses GAAP earnings yield 2.8%; FFO/AFFO lens gives 6.3% AFFO yield
b1 fcfp is NaN for MAA (REIT cash-flow definition); AFFO used instead
MAA.next_earnings_date_basis: estimate from the 29 Oct 2025 date; not confirmed
MAA.confidence_in_thesis: medium: strong balance-sheet and operating discipline, but recovery timing in Sun Belt supply is uncertain

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row. Price implies about 1.5% a year 10-year AFFO growth (8.5% cost of equity) vs my base of about 3%.

MAA.scenario_basis: Starting 2026 AFFO guide midpoint $7.50; bear AFFO $7.0 at 13x; base AFFO +3%/+4%/+4% at 16x; bull +5%/yr at 18x; dividend $6.12/yr; 3-year horizon from $118.35.
